text.jp:
かつてベルトランは、アラゴ王国の中で
将来を有望視されていた将軍でした。
text.official_en:
Bertrand used to be a general in Arago—his future in
the kingdom looked bright.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
生前のキジェルモ様は、彼のことを
信頼できる人物と、高く評価しておりました。
text.official_en: Lord Guillermo certainly respected and trusted him.
text.real_en: When he was alive, Quijermo-sama held him in high regard as someone he could trust.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの日、ベルトランからもちかけられた
要請に応じたのは、それがあったからでした。
text.official_en:
That was why he responded to Bertrand's request
for parley.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
しかし……あのときレヒネルの放った、
あの一本の矢さえなければ、
text.official_en:
Then came the single arrow that Lechner loosed
from the ramparts...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今とは違った形の未来があったかもしれぬと
思うと……いたたまれなくなり申す。
text.official_en:
It's unbearable, wondering how differently things
would have gone if not for that.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
レダ嬢、忠告として、これだけは言っておく。
白髪鬼は雑念をもって倒せる相手ではないぞ。
text.official_en:
Miss Leda, a word of caution. You will not win
facing the White-Maned Demon distracted.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何しろ、戦車の試煉を与えられ、
これまで生き延びてきたような男だ。
text.official_en:
This is the man who was given the Trial of the
Chariot and survived.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
その実力は間違いなく、大闘技場の歴史でも
稀有な水準に達していることだろう。
text.official_en:
His skills are doubtless unrivaled in the colosseum's
long history.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
復讐心に囚われて目を曇らせ、
相手を見ることを怠らぬようにすることだ。
text.official_en:
Please, do not allow your lust for revenge to cloud
your eyes during the fight ahead.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
次の試合が終わったら、ボクも自分の
お母さんと話をしてみようと思ってるんだ。
text.official_en:
I've been thinking... After this match, I'm gonna have
a talk with my mom.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
お母さんの言葉を聞いて、
自分の言葉で想いを伝えて……
text.official_en:
Y'know. Hear what she has to say. Try to say how I
feel with words and stuff.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
その上で、また喧嘩になっちゃったら、
もうそれは諦めるしか無いんだけど。
text.official_en:
If we still end up fighting afterward, then I guess I
have to give up.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
試合の後で、ボク自身がどうすればいいのか、
一度、ちゃんと相談してみたかったから。
text.official_en:
But it seems like it's worth one more shot—talking to
her about what I do next.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア

text.jp:
いよいよベルトランとの決勝ね。
ここまで、随分いろんなことがありましたわ。
text.official_en:
At long last, your showdown with Bertrand! What an
eventful journey it's been to get here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……ふうん？　レイリダーナ、あなた、
思っていたよりも随分いい顔をしているわ。
text.official_en: Hmm. You seem strangely unaffected, Leilidahna.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どこか憑き物が落ちたような顔というか。
これなら、余計な心配はいらなさそうですわ。
text.official_en:
Indeed, as if you've been liberated from some terrible
burden. I suppose we had nothing to fret about then!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
であれば、あとは全力を尽くすのみ。
万全の支度をして臨まなければね。
text.official_en:
In that case, all that's left is to put in your best effort.
We must be prepared for anything!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さて……いよいよ其方の
宿願を果たすときがきたか。
text.official_en:
The time has finally come for your long-held desire
to be fulfilled.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
実際のところ……よくここまで
勝ち上がってきたものだ。
text.official_en: I can't help but be astonished you made it this far.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
其方の執念が、この勝負を
引き寄せたのであろう。
text.official_en:
It was your indefatigable nature that brought you to
this match.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここに及んで、もはや妾から
改めて其方に言うことなど何も無い。
text.official_en: There's nothing more for me to say now.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
己のすべてを尽くし、
仲間を頼り……頑張るのだぞ。
text.official_en:
Other than...expend every effort, and rely on
your friends. Do your very best.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
たとえどんな結末を迎えようと、
悔いの残らぬよう、魂の炎を燃やすがいい。
text.official_en:
No matter the outcome, shine brightly enough that
you may have nothing to regret.
